title: AAV Injection and Dorsal Root Potential Recording for Optogenetic Modulation
author: Kosugi, Sidikejiang, et al.

steps.title: Inject anesthetic cocktail
steps.instruction: Inject intraperitoneally 0.2 mg/kg medetomidine, 2.0 mg/kg midazolam, and 2.5 mg/kg butorphanol; verify depth by pupil size and flexion reflex to paw pinch.

steps.title: Shave, position, and monitor
steps.instruction: Shave back (sternum to tail), ventral surface (larynx to abdomen), and both thighs (ventral and dorsal); place rat on heating pad in supine position with head flat (use paper towel under neck if needed); bind limbs; begin monitoring heart rate (200–350 bpm), oxygen saturation (>95 %), and rectal temperature (35–38 °C).

steps.title: Perform tracheotomy
steps.instruction: Create a 20 mm skin incision above the trachea between ear and shoulders, expose and isolate the trachea, pass two 2‑0 braided silk sutures underneath, incise the trachea between sutures, insert a horizontal Y‑shaped tube, secure the tube by tying the caudal suture first, then the rostral, then both together; add a 2‑0 silk loop around the tube bifurcation and tie again; close skin with non‑absorbable suture, connect tube to ventilator, start mechanical ventilation and monitor chest‑ventilator synchrony, then switch anesthesia to 0.5–1 % isoflurane.

steps.title: Place femoral IV catheter
steps.instruction: Make a 20 mm incision on the medial thigh skin, open with a retractor, expose and isolate the femoral vein proximally, ligate all vein branches, pass two 4‑0 braided silk sutures underneath the vein, clamp the vein proximal to the sutures with a micro serrefine, ligate the distal vein, make an incision just proximal to the ligature and insert the catheter, tie the sutures around the vein (proximal then distal then together), place a 2‑0 silk suture to the skin at the distal end and wrap around the catheter, withdraw the syringe slightly to confirm no blood backflow, close skin with non‑absorbable suture, and secure the catheter to the thigh with surgical tape.

steps.title: Turn animal prone
steps.instruction: Rotate the rat to the prone position; optionally remove ECG, SpO₂, rectal temperature probes and ventilator tubing.

steps.title: Laminectomy and DRG exposure
steps.instruction: Make a skin incision from just above the floating rib to just above the iliac crest; dissect erector spinae muscles to expose spinous processes Th13–S1; expose articular processes using fine scissors, bone curette, and micro curette; perform a laminectomy from L1 to S1 with a bone rongeur while holding vertebral bodies with toothed forceps and maintaining spinal extension; expose L4 and L5 dorsal root ganglia, taking care to minimize bleeding.

steps.title: Expose sciatic nerve
steps.instruction: Make a 15 mm incision on the lateral thigh skin, locate the sciatic nerve between the vastus lateralis and biceps femoris muscles, and isolate the nerve approximately 20 mm from surrounding tissue using a glass rod with a bent tip.

steps.title: Fix animal in stereotaxic frame
steps.instruction: Secure the rat in a stereotaxic frame ensuring the endotracheal tube and intravenous catheter remain intact; re‑check ventilation; optionally remove monitoring probes again.

steps.title: Immobilize spine and limbs
steps.instruction: Clamp the upper thoracic spine and the base of the tail; suspend the limbs with the stereotaxic frame to keep the body and limbs elevated.

steps.title: Create mineral oil pool
steps.instruction: Raise skin and muscle around the exposed DRG and nerve, tie them to form a pool filled with mineral oil warmed to 36–40 °C; periodically monitor oil temperature and volume.

steps.title: Induce neuromuscular blockade
steps.instruction: Inject rocuronium bromide intravenously at 10 mg/kg to achieve neuromuscular blockade.

steps.title: Open dura
steps.instruction: Pierce the dura with a sharp needle.

steps.title: Separate dorsal roots
steps.instruction: Identify the L4 and L5 dorsal roots and separate them from surrounding tissue using a glass rod with a bent tip while the preparation remains immersed in mineral oil.
